subject: Tamil Nadu crop loss relief input subsidy irrigated natural calamity
text: Tamil Nadu. Input subsidy for crop loss of 33% and above, assured irrigated areas: Rs.17,000 per hectare, at least Rs.2,000 per farmer, restricted to sown areas.

source.doc: G.O.(Ms).No.579 Revenue and Disaster Management Dt.09.12.2023 - financial assistance to victims of natural calamities

subject: Tamil Nadu crop loss relief input subsidy rainfed natural calamity
text: Tamil Nadu. Input subsidy for crop loss of 33% and above, crops other than paddy in rainfed areas: Rs.8,500 per hectare, at least Rs.1,000 per farmer, restricted to sown areas.

source.doc: G.O.(Ms).No.579 Revenue and Disaster Management Dt.09.12.2023 - financial assistance to victims of natural calamities

subject: Tamil Nadu crop loss relief input subsidy perennial agro forestry
text: Tamil Nadu. Input subsidy for crop loss of 33% and above, perennial crops and agro forestry: Rs.22,500 per hectare, at least Rs.2,500 per farmer, restricted to sown areas.

source.doc: G.O.(Ms).No.579 Revenue and Disaster Management Dt.09.12.2023 - financial assistance to victims of natural calamities

subject: Tamil Nadu micro irrigation drip sprinkler subsidy small marginal
text: Tamil Nadu. Micro irrigation subsidy, 2026-27: 100% for small and marginal farmers, 75% for other farmers.

subject: Tamil Nadu organic farming incentive per acre
text: Tamil Nadu. Organic farming incentive, 2026-27: Rs.4,000 per acre.

subject: Tamil Nadu green manure ploughing subsidy per acre
text: Tamil Nadu. Ploughing subsidy for incorporating green manure crops, 2026-27: Rs.3,000 per acre.

subject: Tamil Nadu crop insurance PMFBY allocation state fund
text: Tamil Nadu. Crop insurance (PMFBY) allocation from the State fund, 2026-27: Rs.648.55 crore, in 14 clusters of 37 districts.
